package ui

import (
 "testing"
 "github.com/egoist/mygo/internal/platform"
)

func TestWinOneFastSelectionCommitsBeforeNextFrame(t *testing.T) {
 const sentence="Fast selection 内容"
 var selected string
 tt:=NewTester(func(c *Context){Text(c,sentence).Selectable().Width(400);selected=c.SelectedText()},440,180)
 box,ok:=tt.Find(sentence);if !ok {t.Fatal("text missing")}
 // Both input events arrive before another frame. Human drags can also end
 // between paints, so the last coordinate must be committed on mouse-up.
 tt.rt.event(platform.SurfaceEvent{Kind:platform.PointerDown,X:float64(box.X+1),Y:float64(box.Y+box.H/2),Button:0})
 tt.rt.event(platform.SurfaceEvent{Kind:platform.PointerUp,X:float64(box.X+box.W-1),Y:float64(box.Y+box.H/2),Button:0})
 tt.Frame()
 if selected!=sentence {t.Fatalf("final selection=%q",selected)}
}
